purpose: Identify an action as about to begin.
keywords: I am just about to leave home.
I am just about to eat lunch.
He called while I was thinking of calling him. I was just about to make the call.
restrictions: This form locates the action immediately before its start; ているところ and たところ mark other stages.
mistake: The nonpast verb does not mean the action is already underway.

segments.role: Identify an action as about to begin. Dictionary-form verb + ところ.
